_comment: Agent specs (.cursor/, AGENTS.md), ADRs/decisions, company-OS docs, AND full commit history (every change + its reasoning; a revert becomes a failure signal). Set docs/history to false to skip either. tokenEnv is only needed for private repos.

query: SELECT id, title, body AS content, created_at, decision FROM your_table WHERE created_at > now() - interval '365 days' ORDER BY created_at
_comment: Any table where a row carries a decision/outcome + its rationale. Map your column names in `columns`. Use a READ-ONLY DB role and reference it via dsnEnv (never inline the DSN). Drop this source if you have no such table.

Issues + PRs (titles, descriptions, review threads) — where decision discussion lives. Merged PR -> success, closed 'not planned' -> failure, feeding outcome-weighted recall. Remove if you don't use GitHub issues/PRs.
Optional: any internal JSON API (runbooks, wiki export, knowledge base). `itemsPath` locates the array in the response; `fields` maps record keys. Remove if not applicable.
